enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Breathe deeply. Turn on back. Sleep.

Wake up. Sit up. Swing legs off bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Rub hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out eggs and bread. Pick up kettle. Fill with water. Turn on kettle. Put tea bag in mug. Pour hot water. Add milk. Stir. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil. Pour eggs. Scramble. Turn off cooker. Put eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Talk with Member 1. Clear dishes. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the desk, turning on the computer and monitor, checking emails and reviewing the day's arts administration tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Press power button on computer. Press power button on monitor. Adjust chair. Open email application. Click inbox. Read emails. Open calendar. Review tasks. Pick up pen. Write notes. Check phone. Open task list. Highlight priorities. Close email. Open document. Type outline.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on arts administration duties: scheduling exhibitions, answering correspondence, updating grant records
enriched_activities.desc: Open spreadsheet. Type data. Click cells. Scroll. Open document. Type paragraphs. Answer emails. Write replies. Make phone calls. Talk on phone. Take notes. Open grant records. Update fields. Save file. Open scheduling software. Enter exhibition dates. Adjust times. Send confirmation. Print documents. File papers.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out leftovers. Put in microwave. Set timer. Press start. Wait. Take out. Sit at table. Eat lunch. Talk with Member 1. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes. Put away leftovers. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work-from-home arts administration tasks: budget spreadsheets, meeting notes, program planning
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open budget spreadsheet. Enter numbers. Use calculator. Type notes. Open program planning document. Outline steps. Add deadlines. Save file. Check email. Reply to message. Update calendar. Print schedule. File document. Close programs.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking around the neighbourhood for fresh air and a coffee break with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open door. Step outside. Walk down path. Turn left. Walk along street. Talk with Member 1. Breathe fresh air. Stop at coffee shop. Open door. Order coffee. Pay. Receive coffee. Walk back. Enter house. Remove shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work-from-home arts administration tasks: budget spreadsheets, meeting notes, program planning
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open spreadsheet. Type data. Click cells. Scroll. Open document. Type paragraphs. Answer emails. Write replies. Make phone calls. Talk on phone. Take notes. Open grant records. Update fields. Save file. Open scheduling software. Enter exhibition dates. Adjust times. Send confirmation. Print documents. File papers.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with Member 1 on the induction cooker, eating, then cleaning up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables and meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Stir fry vegetables. Add meat. Cook. Turn off cooker. Set table. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 1. Clear table. Wash dishes. Wipe counter. Put away leftovers.

enriched_activities.activity: Switching to freelance illustration work: sketching and refining client artwork on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open illustration software. Pick up stylus. Draw on tablet. Sketch outline. Refine lines. Use eraser. Add color. Adjust layers. Save file. Open client brief. Read requirements. Make changes. Save again. Close software.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room and vacuuming the floor with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up items from floor. Put on shelves. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in. Turn on. Vacuum floor. Move furniture. Turn off. Unplug. Put away vacuum. Talk with Member 1. Fluff pillows. Fold blanket. Turn on light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with the TV and a sketchbook, unwinding after the workday with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Pick up sketchbook. Open. Pick up pencil. Draw. Talk with Member 1. Watch TV. Laugh. Put down pencil. Stretch. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Pick up pencil. Draw more. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with the TV and a sketchbook, unwinding after the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Pick up sketchbook. Open. Pick up pencil. Draw. Watch TV. Put down pencil. Stretch. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Turn off TV.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off water. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and jotting down illustration ideas by the desk lamp with the space heater on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on space heater. Sit at desk. Pick up book. Open. Read. Pick up pen. Write notes. Close book. Turn off lamp. Turn off heater. Stand up. Walk to bed. Lie down.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Push blanket down. Breathe deeply. Turn on back. Sleep.
